resources.name: SRIM (Stopping and Range of Ions in Matter)
resources.notes: Generates stopping power and projected range tables for protons and alphas in boron. The agent must obtain numerical data (e.g., via SRIM software) and fit them to smooth functions.

resources.name: Sikora 11B(p,α)8Be cross sections
resources.notes: Total and differential cross section data for the 11B(p,α)8Be reaction, including angular distributions in the center-of-mass frame. Required for reaction-rate integrals and angular weighting of alphas.

resources.name: ECPSSR K‑shell ionization cross sections
resources.notes: Theoretical model (Brandt & Lapicki) for proton‑induced K‑shell ionization of boron. The agent may implement the formulas from the reference or use publicly available datasets derived from the theory.

resources.name: Wilson–Dennison electron range approximation
resources.notes: Mid‑energy formula for electron projected range in materials; used to compute the average escape distance and energy loss for Auger electrons in boron.

resources.name: Reference Mathematica implementation
resources.notes: Optional; the paper’s original Mathematica code. Not required for reproduction but can serve as a reference for the algorithm.
